items.raw_excerpt: Coimbra recebe milhares de fãs ansiosos pelo concerto dos lendários Guns N’ Roses. Entre eles esteve Manuel Fernandes, natural de…
items.summary_en: Thousands of fans gathered in Coimbra for a Guns N' Roses concert. Among them was Manuel Fernandes, who brought a special shirt signed by lead singer Axl Rose. The local fan shared the story of how he got the memorable autograph.
items.summary_ko: 코임브라에서 건즈 앤 로시스 콘서트를 보기 위해 수천 명의 팬이 모였다. 그중 한 명인 마누엘 페르난데스는 보컬 액슬 로즈가 직접 사인한 특별한 셔츠를 가져왔다. 현지 팬은 그 잊지 못할 사인을 어떻게 받았는지 이야기를 들려주었다.
items.title_en: Fan Shows Off Shirt Signed by Axl Rose at Guns N' Roses Concert in Coimbra

items.raw_excerpt: This vibrant Karoo farming community has history, outdoor adventures for everyone, and a bunch of farm stalls to delight.
items.summary_en: This article explores a farming community in the Karoo region of South Africa. The community features historical sites including an ominous tunnel and an old train, along with outdoor adventures and charming farm stalls. Visitors can discover the Poor School and various local padstals that showcase the area's rich heritage.
items.summary_ko: 이 기사는 남아프리카공화국 카루 지역의 농촌 공동체를 소개합니다. 불길한 터널과 오래된 기차 등 역사적인 장소와 야외 모험, 매력적인 농장 가게가 마련되어 있습니다. 방문객들은 빈민학교와 지역의 파드스탈을 탐방하며 유산을 체험할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Exploring the ominous tunnel, the train, the Poor School and padstal discoveries

items.raw_excerpt: Bali's Immigration department has banned two Dutch expats from Indonesia for organising a run club event '"fraught with discrimination against local residents".
items.summary_en: Indonesia has banned two Dutch expats from the country. They allegedly organised a run club event that discriminated against local residents. The immigration department says the event was not inclusive.
items.summary_ko: 인도네시아 발리 당국이 지역 주민을 차별한 러닝클럽 행사를 기획한 혐의로 네덜란드 남성 2명의 입국을 불허했다. 이민국은 해당 행사가 현지 주민을 배척했다고 밝혔다. 두 사람은 인도네시아에서 추방 조치를 받았다.
items.title_en: Bali bans two Dutch men over run club discrimination

items.raw_excerpt: A nursing home in Selfoss is operating with less than half the recommended proportion of professionally qualified staff, according to a review by Iceland’s Directorate of Health, which also identified shortcomings in facilities, communication and workplace culture. The inspection found that professionally qualified employees make up just 27% of Hraunbúðir’s workforce, compared with a recommended…
items.summary_en: A nursing home in Selfoss, Iceland, has less than half the recommended proportion of qualified staff. A health inspection also found problems with facilities, communication, and workplace culture.

items.title_en: Selfoss Nursing Home Falls Short of Staffing Standards
items.title_original: Hraunbúðir Nursing Home Falls Well Short of Staffing Standards, Report Finds

items.raw_excerpt: For 250 years, the space was dedicated solely to navigation, but it can now be visited.
items.summary_en: A historic Portuguese lighthouse that was closed to visitors for 250 years has finally reopened. The lighthouse at Cabo da Roca, the westernmost point of mainland Europe, was previously used only for maritime navigation. Visitors can now explore the iconic landmark and enjoy stunning views of the Atlantic Ocean.
items.summary_ko: 250년간 항해에만 사용되었던 포르투갈의 상징적인 등대가 드디어 일반인에 개방되었다. 유럽 본토의 가장 서쪽 끝에 위치한 카보 다 로카의 등대는 이제 방문객들이 태평양의 장관을 감상할 수 있게 되었다.
items.title_en: Iconic Portuguese lighthouse at Cabo da Roca reopens to public
items.title_ko: 카보 다 로카의 상징적인 등대가 대중에 다시 열려

items.summary_en: Police and park rangers are conducting joint patrols in Poland's Tatra National Park after a series of tourist rule-breaking incidents, including a Ukrainian influencer who drove a sports car to a famous lake. Bathing in protected lakes and going off marked trails can damage the park's fragile ecosystem, and fines for such offences range from 50 to 1,000 zloty.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드 타트라 국립공원에서 경찰과 공원 관리원이 합동 순찰을 실시하고 있습니다. 우크라이나 인플루언서가 호수까지 스포츠카를 몰고 가는 등 관광객들의 규칙 위반 사례가 발생했기 때문입니다. 보호된 호수에서 수영하거나 지정된 산책로를 이탈하면 취약한 생태계가 훼손될 수 있으며, 위반 시 50~1,000즈워티의 벌금이 부과됩니다.
items.title_en: Poland's Tatra National Park Steps Up Patrols After Tourist Offences

items.raw_excerpt: Frustration is mounting among residents as the ongoing Pikitup workers' strike continue.
